# Diagnova Labs

> Better Diagnosis. Healthier Tomorrow.

Diagnova Labs is an enterprise diagnostic pathology and home sample collection service. We provide NABL accredited clinical laboratory testing, full-body health evaluations, and preventative checkup packages across India.

## Core Clinical Offerings

- **Doorstep Sample Collection**: 60-minute arrival window with temperature-controlled cold-chain phlebotomy.
- **Flagship Packages**:
  - Healthy India 2026 Full Body Checkup Advance Plus (92 parameters including CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid Profile, Thyroid, HbA1c, and Urine).
  - Be Healthy Comprehensive Health Package (with HbA1c & Vitamin D/B12).
  - Diagnova Diabetic Checkup Prime.
  - Life Maximiser Male / Female Executive Packages.
- **Pathology Test Directory**: Individual tests covering Complete Blood Count (CBC), Fasting Blood Glucose, HbA1c, Lipid Profile, Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), Liver Function (LFT), Kidney Function (KFT), Vitamin D3, and Vitamin B12.
- **Accreditation**: 100% NABL & ICMR compliant reference pathology processing.
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard reports in 6 to 24 hours delivered electronically via WhatsApp and Email.

- **Customer Helpline**: 1800-8378-283
